outlets.name: TalkErie.com (Erie local news/radio site)
outlets.credible: Erie-based local news and radio outlet with original reporting on downtown openings (Flagship City Food Hall, its vendors).

outlets.name: The Sentinel / Cumberlink (Lee Enterprises PA regional news)
outlets.credible: Lee Enterprises Pennsylvania regional newspaper; ran a staffed feature on Marley's Island's move to a brick-and-mortar in Erie.

outlets.name: Erie Arts & Culture — Refugee & New American Owned Business Directory
outlets.credible: Nonprofit arts-and-culture organization's vetted directory of 70+ refugee/new-American-owned Erie businesses; a community/nonprofit feature the brief accepts as credible for the immigrant-food scene.

outlets.name: Flagship City District (Erie Downtown Development Corp. — official)
outlets.credible: Official site of the EDDC-run downtown district that operates the Flagship City Food Hall; authoritative for its vendor roster and vendor profiles (e.g., Dina's Dominican).
